description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10³, with tick labels at 10⁰, 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. A black line with circular markers, representing “Base”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 63) and increases to approximately (10³, 68). A light-brown line with diamond markers, representing “MEND”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 65) and increases to approximately (10³, 74). A blue line with triangular markers, representing “FT”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 64) and increases to approximately (10³, 71). A pink line with triangular markers, representing “MEMIT”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 67) and declines to approximately (10³, 73). A red line with triangular markers, representing “IKE”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 66) and declines to approximately (10³, 70). A green line with square markers, representing “ROME”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 72) and increases to approximately (10³, 78).
